title: •Han
caption: •Han (V)
lore: Corellian. Graduated with honors from the Imperial Academy. Dishonorably discharged. Wanders the galaxy building a reputation as a gambler and hot-shot pilot.
game_text: {pilot:3}, 4: _Falcon_. While armed with a blaster, Han’s defense value and weapon destiny draws are +2. Force retrieval with Or Be Destroyed is immune to Secret Plans. While Or Be Destroyed on table, immune to attrition < Han’s power.
